title: In Utero
studio_context: Pachyderm, Cannon Falls, Minnesota, 13-21 February 1993: basic tracks live as a band, about 30 mics round the kit, the room's own reverb; Very Ape and Tourette's drums in the kitchen. Scott Litt remixed Heart-Shaped Box and All Apologies.

drum_performances.name: Dave Grohl
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Albini's room sound on the same kit: Heart-Shaped Box's backbeat, and Scentless Apprentice, built on Grohl's riff and credited to all three.
